style: anime storyboard, clean lineart, flat muted colors, soft cel shading, consistent character design, very aesthetic, masterpiece
global_prompt: 1boy, 1cat, four successive moments of ONE continuous locked low side-view wide shot, unchanged camera and identical room geometry. A simple tall wooden table occupies the LEFT half of the room; its two thin legs leave a clear open view of the floor under the tabletop. A red toy cube stays on the floor at far left under table. Same child on RIGHT and same cat under table on LEFT in every panel, full child and cat visible. Cat faces right toward child throughout. Open floor between them, cream wall, daylight. The child notices the cat, crouches, extends an empty hand and the cat backs LEFT farther beneath the table, away from hand. No physical contact.

C.appearance: boy, short dark brown hair, mustard yellow hoodie, green shorts, white socks

K.appearance: small white cat, orange ears, orange tail, green eyes

negative: lowres, watermark, logo, speech bubbles, text, bad anatomy, extra limbs, duplicate objects
